propositions: A gate-sidecar reader must derive llm_calls and latency metrics by summing over REVIEW_RESULT.metrics blocks only (never from COMPLETION_VERDICT, which carries no metrics block).
cost_per_accepted_change is computed as sum of llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records; returns None (Unavailable) when zero accepted closes exist.
first_pass_verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first by filename order) COMPLETION_VERDICT record is a completion_verifier_pass_v1.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record matching the same gate field value; interval is PASS timestamp minus ERROR timestamp; ERROR with no following same-gate PASS remains an open interval.

The reader performs a single raw ordered scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files per ticket, sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix, without using schema-guarded helper functions that filter or return only the most recent record.
All metrics register into src/rebar/metrics/registry.py with source='sidecar' (authoritative) and are read-only derivations (no writes).
